source: NOAA NHC GIS (KMZ) + Tropical Weather Outlook

outlook.discussion: 1. South of Southern Mexico: An area of low pressure is forecast to form offshore of southern Mexico during the early to middle part of next week. Environmental conditions appear conducive for gradual development thereafter, and a tropical depression could form during the latter half of next week while it moves generally westward to west-northwestward over the eastern and central portions of the East Pacific. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...medium...60 percent.
